name: Medium Engine
description: An on/off signal controls engine startup and throttle signal controls energy output.
shortDescription: Medium diesel engine that can be connected to powered components.

logicNodes.label: Starter
logicNodes.description: Increases the engine RPS using electrical power to start up the engine.

logicNodes.label: Throttle
logicNodes.description: Standard value between 0 and 1 that controls the throttle of the engine.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: Output value giving data info on engine speed.

logicNodes.label: Temperature
logicNodes.description: Output value giving data info on engine temperature.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: The power supplied by the engine for inputting to other components.

logicNodes.label: Fuel
logicNodes.description: The fuel supply for the engine.

logicNodes.label: Air
logicNodes.description: The air supply for the engine.

logicNodes.label: In Coolant
logicNodes.description: The return flow (cold) for the coolant system.

logicNodes.label: Out Coolant
logicNodes.description: The output flow (hot) for the coolant system.

logicNodes.label: Exhaust
